title: Active release identity and zero-Champion lifecycle
purpose: Load/validate the active release mirror, enforce EA identity parity, and preserve zero-Champion baseline until explicit promotion.
entry_condition: Runtime or acceptance requires active release identity.

transitions.action: Read package/runtime active release mirrors and portable artifact paths
Accept valid baseline with null Strategy/Model Champion
Accept release only when promoted authority and artifact identity are valid

invariants: Baseline is not silently called Champion.
failure_behavior: Any identity/mirror/path mismatch fails closed before deployment authority is consumed.
restart_behavior: Reload always revalidates current file identities.
rollback_behavior: Invalid candidate release does not replace previously accepted source/release authority.
